units.source_text: 源氏公子常常对明石道人说：

en.t: Prince Genji often said to the Akashi monk:

units.source_text: “我听了近来的涛声，便想听赏令嫒的琴音。

en.t: “When I hear the sound of the waves these days, I long to hear and enjoy your daughter’s koto music.

units.source_text: 不是这个季节，琴音再妙，也觉索然乏味。”

en.t: If it were not this season, even the most exquisite koto music would feel dull and empty.”

units.source_text: 明石道人听了这话，忽然下了决心。

en.t: Hearing these words, the Akashi monk suddenly made up his mind.

units.source_text: 他悄悄地拣个吉日，不管夫人犹豫不决，

en.t: He quietly chose an auspicious day, paying no heed to his wife’s hesitation,

units.source_text: 也不教众徒弟知道，独自用心设计，

en.t: and without letting his many disciples know, he planned everything carefully by himself,

units.source_text: 把房室装饰得辉煌灿烂。

en.t: decorating the rooms until they shone with splendid brilliance.

units.source_text: 于十三之夜皓月初升之时，

en.t: On the thirteenth night, just as the bright moon began to rise,

units.source_text: 吟着古歌“良宵花月真堪惜，只合多情慧眼看”，

en.t: he recited an old poem: “A fine night, flowers, and moon are truly precious; only a feeling heart and discerning eye should behold them,”

units.source_text: 请公子驾往山边内宅。

en.t: and invited the prince to visit the inner residence by the mountain.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得他有些风流自得，

en.t: Prince Genji thought the monk seemed somewhat pleased with his own elegance,

units.source_text: 但仍换上常礼服，整饰一番，于夜深时出发。

en.t: but he nevertheless changed into his usual formal robes, made himself presentable, and set out late at night.

units.source_text: 道人早已准备着华丽的车辆。

en.t: The monk had already prepared a splendid carriage.

units.source_text: 但公子嫌其招摇，不坐车子，乘马而行。

en.t: But the prince disliked its showiness, so he did not ride in the carriage and went on horseback instead.

units.source_text: 随从的只有惟光等数人。

en.t: Only Koremitsu and a few others attended him.

units.source_text: 赴内宅须绕道海边，转入山路，行程稍远。

en.t: To reach the inner residence, they had to go around by the seashore and then turn onto a mountain road, so the journey was somewhat long.

units.source_text: 一路上赏玩浦上各处景色，

en.t: Along the way, he enjoyed the scenery at various points along the bay,

units.source_text: 眺望应与恋人共看的海湾月影，

en.t: and gazed at the moonlight over the inlet, a sight meant to be shared with a beloved.

units.source_text: 首先想起了可爱的紫姬，

en.t: The first person who came to his mind was dear Lady Murasaki,

units.source_text: 但愿就此策马直赴京都。

en.t: and he wished he could spur his horse straight on to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 便独自吟诗：

en.t: Then he quietly recited a poem to himself:
